letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow that dances in your eyes, and each monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. Though our calendars flip between towers and spice markets, my heart never skips a beat—just for you, my cutie. I cherish our shared laughter over chai, the way you turn ordinary moments into unforgettable memories, and the promise that every tomorrow will be brighter because we walk it together. With all my love, today and always.
poem:
In desert dunes or rain‑kissed lanes,  
Your smile’s the compass that sustains.  
From Dubai lights to Ahmedabad’s hue,  
My love, my life—forever you.
